这次你主要想让 AI 帮你做哪一件事？: What is the one thing you want the AI to do for you?
选一个最接近的。拿不准也没关系，后面每一轮都可以改。: Pick the closest one. If you are unsure, that is fine — you can change it in any later round.
目标是从零产出一篇完整的原创内容，不要只是给提纲或思路。: The goal is a complete piece of original content produced from scratch, not just an outline or a set of ideas.
在完整保留原意与信息点的前提下重写，提升表达质量，不要新增未经我确认的事实。: Rewrite while fully preserving the original meaning and every information point, raising the quality of the writing. Do not introduce facts I have not confirmed.
在现有内容基础上做扩写，补充细节、案例与论证，把简略处写透，不要另起炉灶。: Expand on the existing content: add detail, examples and argument, and develop the sketchy parts properly. Do not start over from scratch.
压缩篇幅，保留核心信息与关键细节，删除重复、铺垫和空话。: Compress the length, keep the core message and the key details, and delete repetition, padding and filler.
只需要产出结构大纲与每节要点，不要展开成文。: Produce only the structural outline and the key points of each section. Do not write it out in full.
请给出可以直接运行的完整实现，而不是伪代码或片段示意。: Give me a complete implementation I can run directly — not pseudocode, not an illustrative fragment.
请定位问题根因并给出修复方案，说明为什么会出错，而不只是贴出改好的代码。: Locate the root cause and give me a fix, explaining why it breaks — not just the corrected code.
在保持对外行为不变的前提下重构，改善可读性、可维护性与扩展性。: Refactor without changing external behaviour, improving readability, maintainability and extensibility.
请以严格代码审查的视角逐条指出问题，按严重程度排序，每条都要说明风险与修改建议。: Review this strictly and list the problems one by one, ordered by severity, each with its risk and a suggested change.
请解释这段代码的执行流程与设计意图，重点讲清楚容易误解的地方。: Explain how this code runs and why it was designed this way, focusing on the parts that are easy to misread.
请编写测试用例，必须覆盖正常路径、边界条件与异常输入。: Write test cases that cover the happy path, the boundary conditions and invalid input.
请从数据中提炼有价值的洞察，指出反直觉之处，并说明结论的可靠程度与局限。: Draw out the insights that matter, point out anything counter-intuitive, and state how reliable the conclusions are and where they stop holding.
请对各个方案做横向对比，明确各自的适用条件、代价与风险，最后给出推荐及理由。: Compare the options side by side, spell out when each one applies and what it costs, then finish with a recommendation and the reasoning behind it.
请对该话题做系统性梳理，覆盖现状、主要玩家、关键变量与不确定性。: Give me a systematic overview of the topic: the current state, the main players, the key variables and what is still uncertain.
请做归因分析，区分相关性因素与真正的因果驱动因素，并说明判断依据。: Run a causal analysis that separates correlated factors from the ones actually driving the outcome, and explain how you can tell them apart.
请给出趋势判断与推演逻辑，明确区分事实、合理推断与猜测。: Give me a read on where this is heading and the reasoning behind it, clearly separating fact, reasonable inference and guesswork.
请给出多个差异化的创意方向，每个方向说明核心主张、目标人群与记忆点。: Give me several distinct creative directions; for each one state the core claim, the audience, and the hook that makes it stick.
请产出可直接使用的推广文案，语言要贴合目标平台的内容调性，避免自嗨式表达。: Produce promo copy I can use as-is, written to fit the tone of the target platform and free of self-congratulatory filler.
请产出多个标题方案，覆盖不同情绪切入点，并标注每个方案适合的人群与风险。: Give me several headline options that come at it from different emotional angles, and note who each one suits and what it risks.
请刻画目标人群画像，包含真实使用场景、核心痛点、决策顾虑与信息获取习惯。: Build a profile of the target audience: the real situations they are in, their core pain points, what holds them back from deciding, and where they get their information.
请给出可落地的活动策划方案，包含机制设计、传播路径、转化钩子与效果衡量方式。: Give me a campaign plan that can actually be run: the mechanic, the path it spreads along, the conversion hook, and how the result gets measured.
我要真正理解: I want to really get it
请把这个概念讲到我真正理解为止，从直觉出发，再过渡到严谨表述。: Explain this concept until I genuinely understand it — start from intuition, then move to the rigorous version.
我该按什么顺序学: What order should I learn in
请给出循序渐进的学习路径，标明每个阶段的重点、里程碑与常见误区。: Give me a step-by-step learning path, marking the focus, the milestones and the usual traps at each stage.
请整理成便于复习的笔记结构，突出主干逻辑与易忘的关键点。: Organize this into a note structure that is easy to review, foregrounding the main line of reasoning and the points that are easy to forget.
请出题检验我的掌握程度，题目要有区分度，并在最后给出答案与解析。: Set questions that genuinely test my understanding, with enough range to separate real knowledge from guessing, and give the answers and explanations at the end.
请提炼这份材料的核心内容，保留原作者的论证脉络，不要掺入你自己的评价。: Distil the core of this material, keeping the author's own line of argument. Do not mix in your own evaluation.
请产出结构完整的方案，逻辑上能经得起决策者的追问，重点讲清楚价值、代价与可行性。: Produce a properly structured proposal whose logic survives a decision-maker's follow-up questions, with the value, the cost and the feasibility all made clear.
请按汇报场景组织内容，结论前置，论据精炼，方便我在有限时间里讲清楚。: Organize this for a reporting setting: conclusion first, evidence trimmed, so I can get it across in limited time.
请做复盘，区分主观原因与客观原因，指出哪些做法可以沉淀成机制。: Run a retrospective that separates what was within our control from what was not, and point out which practices are worth turning into a process.
请起草沟通内容，把诉求、背景与下一步动作讲清楚，语气得体但立场明确。: Draft the message so that the ask, the background and the next step are all clear, in a tone that is appropriate but takes a clear position.
请把目标拆解成可执行的任务，明确优先级、依赖关系与验收标准。: Break the goal into executable tasks with clear priorities, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
请做发散式头脑风暴，先要数量，想法之间要有明显差异，不要在同一思路上反复变体。: Brainstorm divergently — quantity first, and the ideas should differ clearly from one another rather than being variations on a single thought.
要朗朗上口: Something that rolls off the tongue
请产出多个命名方案，覆盖不同风格取向，说明每个方案的含义与适用场景。: Give me several naming options across different stylistic directions, explaining what each one means and where it fits.
请构建故事框架，明确核心冲突、人物动机与情绪走向。: Build a story framework with a clear central conflict, character motivation and emotional arc.
请给出有画面感的概念描述，包含主体、氛围、色彩倾向与关键视觉元素。: Give me a concept description with real visual presence: subject, mood, color direction and the key visual elements.
请把信息重新组织成清晰的分类结构，去掉冗余，保留关键细节。: Reorganize this into a clear structure of categories, cutting redundancy while keeping the key details.
请直接产出可用的成品内容，不要只给思路或框架。: Produce finished, usable content directly — not just ideas or a framework.
请给出明确判断，并说明支撑结论的关键理由与前提条件。: Give me a clear judgement, and state the key reasons behind it and the conditions it depends on.
怎么才能做成: How do we make this work
请给出解决问题的具体路径，指出关键卡点与应对办法。: Give me a concrete path to solving this, naming the bottlenecks and how to get past them.
请帮我做决策，明确推荐哪一项，并说明在什么条件下应该改变这个选择。: Help me decide: name the option you recommend, and say what would have to change for a different choice to become the right one.
要有视觉重心和留白: Needs a focal point and breathing room
商业海报用途，画面需要有明确的视觉重心，并在构图时预留放标题文字的空间: Commercial poster use: the frame needs a clear focal point, and the composition must leave space for headline text
社交媒体配图用途，需要在信息流里第一眼就抓住注意力: Social media use: it has to catch the eye at first glance inside a feed
产品展示用途，需要清晰呈现产品的外观、材质与细节: Product showcase use: the appearance, material and details need to read clearly
人物形象设定用途，五官清晰、人体比例准确、姿态自然: Character design use: clear facial features, accurate body proportions, natural pose
用于概念探索，可以大胆尝试，不要求完全写实: For concept exploration — feel free to push it, it does not need to be fully realistic
艺术创作用途，鼓励风格化表达与个人化的视觉语言: Artistic use: stylized expression and a personal visual language are encouraged
场景设定用途，重点在于环境氛围、空间层次与世界观的可信度: Scene design use: the emphasis is on atmosphere, depth in the space, and a world that feels believable
广告宣传片用途，画面需要有商业级的质感与清晰的信息传达: Advertising use: the footage needs a commercial-grade feel and a clear message
前 3 秒要抓人: Hook them in the first 3 seconds
短视频用途，开头三秒必须抓住注意力，节奏紧凑: Short video use: the first three seconds must grab attention, and the pace has to stay tight
叙事片段用途，需要有明确的情绪走向与镜头语言: Narrative use: a clear emotional arc and deliberate camera language
动画风格，画面需要有清晰的线条与统一的作画风格: Animated style: clean linework and a consistent drawing style
产品动态展示用途，需要完整呈现产品的形态、材质与使用场景: Product showcase use: the form, the material and the context of use all need to be presented
氛围素材用途，重点是环境动态、光影变化与情绪营造，不需要人物主体: Atmosphere footage use: the focus is movement in the environment, shifting light and mood — no human subject required
